overall_goal: Add the remaining stock to the pan and continue stirring

goals.description: Pour the remaining broth into the frying pan and mix it in
goals.rationale: The person picks up the saucepan, pours and scrapes all the remaining broth into the frying pan, then stirs the mixture.

goals.description: Periodically stir the contents of the pan to prevent burning
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up the spatula to stir and shake the pan over time to ensure the food does not burn.
